en.ahmedali: I CALL to witness the admonishing Qur'an.
en.ahmedraza: By oath of the renowned Qur’an, (Alphabet of the Arabic language; Allah and to whomever He reveals, know their precise meanings.)
en.daryabadi: By the Qur'an full of admonition.
en.maududi: and by the Qur'an full of exhortation!
en.mubarakpuri: By the Qur'an full of reminding.
en.qaribullah: by the Holy Reading (Koran) of the Remembrance.
en.yusufali: By the Qur'an, Full of Admonition: (This is the Truth).
